headline: GROUP ELEVEN HITS 21.7% Zn+Pb BONANZA IN IRELAND STEP-OUT — 14.7m Zone 550m From Stonepark MRE; Biggest Advance Since 2017 (TSXV: ZNG)
snippet: Group Eleven Resources (TSX-V: ZNG) announced July 23 a new and robust zone of mineralization at its Stonepark Project in Ireland, with a step-out hole cutting 14.7 metres grading 2.0% Zn+Pb including 2.8m at 8.3% Zn+Pb and a 1.0m bonanza at 21.7% Zn+Pb with 4 g/t Ag — located 550 metres from the existing Stonepark MRE and representing the company's most significant advance at the project since 2017. The discovery sits within the lowest 65 metres of the Waulsortian Limestone, the same host horizon as Ireland's world-class zinc-lead belt, and greatly improves the potential for resource growth adjacent to the Ballywire discovery on Group Eleven's PG West Project.

headline: TIGER GOLD DRILLS 685m AT 0.6 g/t AU FROM SURFACE IN COLOMBIA — Porphyry Core Alteration Confirmed at Ceibal; 3 Rigs Active, System Open at 800m (TSXV: TIGR)
snippet: Tiger Gold Corp. (TSX-V: TIGR) released July 23 assay results from three holes at the Ceibal target of its Quinchía Gold Project in Colombia's Mid-Cauca gold belt, with the strongest hole intersecting 685 metres at 0.6 g/t Au from surface and a companion hole returning 568 metres at 0.6 g/t Au from 309.5m depth — extending the system to approximately 800 metres below surface. Critically, a third hole returned the most proximal indicators of the porphyry core to date, with bornite, molybdenite, and covellite in A-type veining between 189 and 249 metres interpreted as potassic alteration, confirming drill programs are converging on the high-temperature, high-grade centre of the system with three rigs still active.

headline: OIL SHOCK STALLS GOLD AT $4,130 — Brent Surges to $95 on New Iran Strikes; 2yr Treasury at 4.30%, FOMC 6 Days Away
snippet: Gold stalled near $4,130 on July 23 as Brent crude surged above $95 per barrel — a six-week high — following new U.S. airstrikes on Iran and tanker attacks near Bab el-Mandeb, driving the two-year Treasury yield to 4.30%, its highest since February 2025, as markets priced in renewed Fed rate-hike risk to counter energy-driven inflation. The oil shock is suppressing gold's geopolitical bid — the metal is again trading as an inflation product rather than a safe haven — with the July 28–29 FOMC meeting and Kevin Warsh's post-decision language now the binary event: neutral guidance opens a path to $4,200, while hawkish signalling risks a retest of $4,000 support.

headline: DISCOVERY MINING CONFIRMS 4km SYSTEM AT PAMOUR — 17.36 g/t Au Over 5.9m Headlines High-Grade Expansion; Stock +8.1% (TSX: DSV)
snippet: Discovery Mining Ltd. (TSX: DSV) reported July 21 that 47 holes totalling 11,003 metres from its 255,000–285,000-metre 2026 program at Pamour Mine in Ontario confirmed and expanded resources across all three open-pit phases and returned high-grade intercepts at multiple new targets — with highlights including 17.36 g/t Au over 5.9m along the Keora Trend, 4.27 g/t over 12.8m at the North Contact Zone, and 3.05 g/t over 30.0m in the central pit — outlining a mineralized system traced over 4.0 km and 300–700 metres depth. Discovery shares jumped 8.1% as investors responded to simultaneous resource expansion and high-grade satellite discoveries that extend the deposit's footprint and overall economics.

headline: NSW APPROVES AERIS' CONSTELLATION COPPER MINE — 2.3Mt at 2.0% Cu Extends Tritton Hub; Construction Starts, Production by Year-End (ASX: AIS)
snippet: The New South Wales Government approved the mining lease for Aeris Resources' (ASX: AIS) Constellation open-pit copper deposit near Nyngan, allowing construction to commence immediately on a deposit of 2.3 million tonnes at 2.0% copper, 0.6 g/t gold, and 3 g/t silver that will supply new ore to the existing Tritton Copper Operations processing infrastructure. Aeris targets first production from Constellation before year-end 2026, extending Tritton's operational runway and adding copper leverage at a time when spot prices hold above US$6/lb; peak operations will support approximately 255 jobs and approximately 125 during construction.

headline: VOLTA CONSOLIDATES 100% OF SPRINGER — Top-10 North American REE + Potential First Gallium Resource; $1M Cash + 10M Shares (CSE: VLTA)
snippet: Volta Metals Ltd. (CSE: VLTA) entered a definitive agreement July 22 to acquire the remaining 20% interest in the Springer Rare Earth and Gallium Deposit near Sturgeon Falls, Ontario — ranked as a top-10 North American rare earth deposit — for $1,000,000 cash plus 10,000,000 shares, simplifying the path to 100% ownership of a project holding REE, gallium, lithium, cesium, and tantalum. Historical drilling on newly acquired ground returns up to 1.97% Total Rare Earth Oxide, and with germanium up 27.8% and gallium in structural North American supply deficit, Volta's full consolidation of the only identified North American gallium resource is strategically timed.

headline: MAGMATIC CONFIRMS GOLD ACROSS 6 WEEBO PROSPECTS — 6m at 1.96 g/t, 8m at 1.52 g/t; 270km² WA Project in Northern Star/Gold Fields Cluster (ASX: MAG)
snippet: Magmatic Resources (ASX: MAG) confirmed July 22 that its 6,573-metre Phase 3 reverse circulation and air core program at the Weebo Gold Project in Western Australia confirmed bedrock gold-bearing lodes across six separate prospects, with key intercepts of 6 metres at 1.96 g/t Au at Otto 2 and 8 metres at 1.52 g/t Au at Ockerburry 3. The 270-square-kilometre Weebo Project sits within a Western Australian gold cluster hosting major deposits operated by Northern Star Resources and Gold Fields; the multi-prospect confirmation validates the company's exploration model and provides a clear platform for defining resource-grade targets in a well-endowed address.

headline: PILBARA MINERALS WEIGHS NGUNGAJU LITHIUM RESTART — Strong Offtake Interest, 4-Month Lead Time; July 30 Quarterly Could Seal the Decision (ASX: PLS)
snippet: Pilbara Minerals (ASX: PLS) disclosed as of July 22 that it is evaluating a restart of its 200,000-tonne-per-year Ngungaju plant — idled since December 2024 during the lithium price collapse — citing strong inbound offtake interest and completed operational readiness work enabling restart within four months of a go-decision, with the July 30 quarterly report expected to carry the final call. The potential restart comes as spodumene prices have surged approximately 196% year-on-year to above $2,000/t CIF China, and the LME Lithium Hydroxide CIF forward curve holds near $19,545/t through Q3 FY27, providing significantly improved economics for Australian hard-rock producers to bring mothballed capacity online.

headline: GOLDSEEK: GOLD IS TRAPPED — Iran War Keeps Inflation Risk Alive, FOMC July 29 Is the Only Exit Valve
snippet: GoldSeek published an editorial noting that gold's performance during the 2026 Iran conflict has revealed a structural market dynamic: rather than rallying on geopolitical risk, gold is being capped or sold as oil spikes translate directly into inflation expectations and Fed rate-hike probability, rendering the traditional safe-haven bid inert until energy prices stabilize. The piece argues that investors must navigate a Fed-first environment in which energy-driven inflation consistently forces real-yield repricing before any safe-haven bid can stick — making Warsh's July 29 post-meeting tone, not the rate decision itself, the only near-term catalyst capable of unlocking gold's next directional leg.

headline: PJX RAISES C$6.3M TO DRILL SULLIVAN-STYLE CRITICAL METALS IN HISTORIC BC DISTRICT — Sullivan-Grade Sedex Found 2023; Permits In Hand, Drilling Starts July (TSXV: PJX)
snippet: PJX Resources Inc. (TSX-V: PJX) completed a C$6.3 million private placement July 23 to fund exploration and drilling across 680-plus km² of mineral claims in British Columbia's Sullivan Mining District — the historic home of one of the world's largest Sedex zinc-lead-silver deposits — targeting a Sullivan-style critical metals deposit at the Dewdney Trail property, where Sullivan deposit-grade mineralization was discovered in 2023, and a Reduced Intrusion Related Gold System target. Drill permits are in hand with drilling commencing in July 2026 at Dewdney Trail, representing PJX's most significant mobilization since its 2023 Sedex discovery confirmed grade at scales comparable to the legendary Sullivan mine.
